Name: Cute Valley- Pink ver. Dino Expanded
Author: K1N0K0SSUP3RGAY
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A simple recolor of the dino hutches from Dino expanded! in the style of Cute Valley Of course!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install smapi(duh)
Install cointent patcher(double duh)
Install Dino expanded! (all all its requirements)
Then come back here and download the recolors!

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Cute pink buildings in the style of cute valley! All the hutches are recolored by me! :3

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Smapi
Content Patcher
Dino expanded
And cute valley! (although you dont need it to function but why would you be downloading it if not?)
